I know you no longer wish to be in touch, and I understand it. I respect it. That is why these questions are not addressed to you. Nothing here asks for an answer, and nothing waits for one. They are meant to be answered quietly, by whoever is holding them, for themselves. Some things are said only to be said, not to be returned. for the night you were born

The Hour of Equal Light

The evening you were born, the sky
held day and night in equal weight;
no bell, no sign, no passing cry,
and no one thought to mark the date.

Eight billion hearts on one round stone,
most never meet, most never know —
and yet, against all odds, my own
small road met yours, a while ago.

Some lights are lent, and never kept;
the comet leaves the sky it crossed.
I will not say that I have wept
for what I had, nor call it lost.

So wherever your road may bend,
a wish for you will stay alight —
no hand held out, no word to send,
just one lamp lit against your night.

Thank you.

For the butterfly, from the shadow

Happy Birthday, Anuva!

Your day arrives in

--hours

Wishing you a very happy birthday. I hope today is full of things you love: good food, good company, and a lot of reasons to smile. May this year bring you health, peace, and success in everything you set your heart on, especially in your exams and the road beyond them. May you be surrounded by people who are kind to you, and may every day of this year be a little brighter than the one before.

Have a wonderful day. You deserve it.

Wherever life takes you, I hope you always find your way into the light. Some people only ever watch it from the shadows, and still wish for it with their whole heart.

Today the last thread is tied. Everything on this site was made slowly, for one person, and it ends here, on her day.

Happy birthday. I hope the years ahead are gentle with you, and that you are always, quietly, well.
